verdict.rationale: Sentry provides official SDKs across platforms ("Drop in the SDK") plus AI-specific tooling like agent tracing SDKs for catching bad tool calls/spend across agents, and an official MCP server/CLI ("npx @sentry/ai install") that lets AI assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex integrate directly. This directly supports AI-native builders wanting to instrument agents via official SDKs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK ergonomics for agentic workflows, and detailed code-level SDK docs in the evidence pack.
